subject: Request: Campus partnership credits + short-term extension
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Morales <e.morales@northbridge.edu>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Northbridge Community Lab Finance <finance@northbridge.edu>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Campus pilot request + short extension request

Hi Priya,

I run the Applied AI Lab at Northbridge Community Lab. We're running a credit-bearing pilot next month for two instructor-led courses (intro AI + applied projects) and we ran out of the self-serve trial credits during initial testing. The cohort starts Aug 24 and we'll need access to about ~300k tokens total for student experiments over 6 weeks.

We'd like to request: 
- A one-time short extension to the self-serve trial so we can finish onboarding (expires Aug 12 currently)
- Academic promo credits (nonprofit/academic rate) sufficient for the 6-week pilot (estimate attached)

I've attached the completed eligibility form and a short CSV with the course list and expected headcount. Procurement also asked whether we can get a PO-ready invoice for any overages.

Attachments: nbcl_eligibility_form.pdf (pdf), nbcl_course-list.csv (csv)

Appreciate any help — this pilot could lead to an institutional adoption across our district if things go well.

Best,
Elena
Dr. Elena Morales
Director, Applied AI Lab
Northbridge Community Lab
Phone: +1-555-213-0987
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Morales <e.morales@northbridge.edu>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Campus pilot request + short extension request

Hi Elena — thanks for reaching out and for the attachments. I'm copying Rachel (partnerships) and Monica (billing) so we can move quickly. A few quick clarifying questions so we can approve the right amount of promo credits: 

1) Is the 300k token estimate total for the entire pilot or per-course? (helps us size monthly burn)
2) Will students be using the public hosted API (our trial) or do you want a dedicated short-term allocation pinned to the institution?
3) Do you have a scanned proof of nonprofit/academic status (letterhead or 501c equivalent) that procurement requires?

Process note: we can issue a self-serve academic credit grant via our credits portal (usually same-day for verified schools) or set up a reserved promo package if you need PO/invoice handling. If you need invoice/PO, Monica will coordinate the billing.

If you can get us the quick answers and the procurement contact, we should be able to confirm an extension + credits by Friday (Aug 14) to hit your Aug 24 start.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Partner Growth — Academic & Nonprofit Programs
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
From: Dr. Elena Morales <e.morales@northbridge.edu>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Campus pilot request + short extension request

Priya — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below (quoted for clarity):

On Mon, Aug 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 1) Is the 300k token estimate total for the entire pilot or per-course?

300k total across both courses (about 60 students total). Peak concurrent usage per student is low (single-turn prompts + 1-2 rounds), so monthly distribution will be skewed in the third and fourth week.

> 2) Will students be using the public hosted API or do you want a dedicated short-term allocation?

Hosted API is fine for this pilot. We don't need a dedicated pool — ease of access for students is important.

> 3) Proof of nonprofit/academic status

Attached: letter_of_accreditation.pdf (on institution letterhead) and the completed eligibility form. Procurement contact is: Karen Lin (karen.lin@northbridge.edu). They asked whether Redwood can issue a PO-ready invoice in the event of overages; if not, we can run a small campus card.

Attachments: letter_of_accreditation.pdf (pdf)

Could we get an expedited extension? Procurement needs confirmation before Aug 20 to finalize the PO.

Thanks — Elena
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Proposed credit grant for NBCL pilot (internal)

Priya / Monica — quick internal note so we don't miss the Aug 20 procurement deadline. I've reviewed the attachments. Recommendation: 
- Issue a one-time academic promo grant of 400,000 tokens (gives a 30% buffer)
- Short extension of current trial expiry to Aug 25 to allow onboarding and initial test runs
- Keep hosted API (no dedicated pool) and set a hard cap on the grant; any usage beyond the grant billed to the institution with a PO or campus card

Monica: please confirm if we can issue a PO-ready invoice for potential overages and what lead time you need from procurement.

If you approve, Priya can send the approval and grant link to Elena and cc billing.

— Rachel
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: Academic pilot credits issued (NBCL) — next steps

Hi Elena / Karen — happy to confirm we've approved a one-time academic promo grant and short extension for your pilot. Summary and next steps: 

What we issued:
- 400,000 academic promo tokens granted to the Northbridge project (NBCL-ACA-2026-08)
- Trial extension applied: hosted-trial expiry extended to 2026-08-25 for the onboarding window
- Hard cap set: usage beyond the 400k grant will be billed and we can accept a PO (Monica will coordinate invoicing).

Links & attachments:
- Credit activation link (self-serve): https://redwood.app/credits/approve/NBCL-ACA-2026-08
- Trial terms (pdf): redwood_trial-terms.pdf
- Shared syllabus folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/nbcl/syllabus-aug2026

Monica, please send a PO-ready invoice template to Karen (karen.lin@northbridge.edu) and confirm expected timelines for billing.

Note on usage monitoring: you'll see token burn in the Console under the project name "NBCL Pilot". We recommend enabling per-route cost alerts — Rachel can help set that up if you want.

If anything changes on timing or headcount, reply here and we'll adjust. Wishing you a smooth launch.

Best regards,
